source: Playwright focus, Escape, rendered-visibility, geometry, and element-under-overlay checks on the collapsed Navigation toolbar in Views UI
wcag_or_apg: WCAG 2.2 SC 1.4.13 Content on Hover or Focus
evidence: EVID-INTERACTION-S-STR-020-HOVER-FOCUS: focusing the collapsed Navigation Blocks link displays a 71.25 by 34 CSS pixel author-controlled tooltip over the main content.
EVID-INTERACTION-S-STR-020-HOVER-FOCUS: pressing Escape while focus remains on the trigger does not dismiss the tooltip.
reproduction_steps: Enable the core Navigation module and use its collapsed desktop toolbar.
Authenticate as an administrator and open /admin/structure/views/view/content/edit/page_1.
Move keyboard focus to the Blocks link in the collapsed Navigation toolbar.
Confirm that the Blocks tooltip appears over the main page content.
Press Escape without moving focus and confirm that the tooltip remains visible.
expected_behavior: Additional content shown on focus can be dismissed without moving focus when it obscures other content.
actual_behavior: The focus-triggered Navigation tooltip overlays the main content and remains visible after Escape; the implementation has no dismissal mechanism that preserves focus on the trigger.
